name: 表面网格能力校验与边界环
display_name: 表面网格能力校验与边界环

input.conditions: 结构合法的 SurfaceMesh。允许开口、退化、孤立点和非流形输入以便诊断。

output.conditions: 结构/组合能力报告；重复面检测仅针对三角形按顶点集合判断。退化面积为浮点零测试，不认证近退化。没有自交、闭实体或全局嵌入合法性证书。

constraints.numerics: Approximate binary64. No exact predicates, no certified near-degenerate topology, no global self-intersection certificate. No fast-math.
constraints.ownership: Inputs borrowed during calls; output owns storage unless explicitly documented as span/reference or shared immutable snapshot. No implicit global I/O.
constraints.errors: Bad shape/domain/index/ID rejected via standard exceptions; allocations may throw. Numeric and I/O failure guarantees are stated in the independent document.
constraints.scope: 结构合法的 SurfaceMesh。允许开口、退化、孤立点和非流形输入以便诊断。 结构/组合能力报告；重复面检测仅针对三角形按顶点集合判断。退化面积为浮点零测试，不认证近退化。没有自交、闭实体或全局嵌入合法性证书。

complexity.operations: 三角形 O(n+C log(C+1))；一般多边形另有 O(sum(face_arity^2)) 顶点 link 遍历。边界环先校验再重建邻接。
complexity.space: O(n+C+m+E)，报告是固定大小；输出边界环另计。
complexity.guarantee: Conditions and backend dependence in the independent document; no unqualified optimality/latency claim

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative owned payload lower bound for the declared path; zero does not mean zero actual memory; excludes live inputs, capacities, output overlap and allocator effects

provenance.implementation: Independently implemented in this project; geometry libraries are design/math references, not copied engine code
